Outpatient clinic note, Alexandria
Date: 2024-06-12
Patient: synthetic case P003, 40-year-old female.

Problems:
Known atrial fibrillation.
- gastro-oesophageal reflux disease
Known hypothyroidism.
Known chronic kidney disease stage 3a.

Medications:
- lisinopril 10mg daily
- bisoprolol 2.5mg OD
- omeprazole 20mg o.d.
- warfarin 3mg OD as per INR
- levothyroxine 50 micrograms OD before breakfast
